load_delayed_memory.description: Allows the model to load a delayed memory report into the session context.
rules: Emit one marker per saved delayed memory. You may emit multiple markers to load multiple reports; already loaded ids are ignored.
id - is a placeholder word; replace placeholder with the 6-character id prefix shown in <DELAYED_MEMORY>.
Available reports are listed in the <DELAYED_MEMORY> block.
If a report is already loaded, use the content placed in <APPENDED_DELAYED_MEMORY>.
